name: Neural Volumes
aliases: Neural Volumes: Learning Dynamic Renderable Volumes from Images
definition: Optimizes a deep 3D convolutional network to predict a discretized RGBα voxel grid and a 3D warp grid, then renders novel views by marching camera rays through the warped voxel grid.
summary: Neural Volumes synthesizes novel views of dynamic scenes by optimizing a 3D convolutional network to predict a voxel grid and warp field, modeling transparency rather than occupancy.
